rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Chained-prompt isolation — don't leak downstream pipeline.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Read both registry files (curriculum/prompts/ae101-m3-fork-quality-side.md, curriculum/prompts/ae101-m3-quality-side-orient.md). They form a real two-step chain via frontmatter (fork produces id m3-quality-worktree; orient requires it). Neither leaks the other's job: the fork prompt asks only for the new path + which files copied, with no forward mention of an orient/confirm step; the orient prompt asks only for directory/branch/CLAUDE-file-load-state/codebase visibility, with no mention of the Ex1/Ex2/Ex3 skill-authoring content still to come in the side lane. Relevant to storytelling because a leak here would collapse the felt experience of 'the side quest sits visibly idle' that the trace's close depends on.
